quests.title: Financial Analyst Master Quest
quests.description: Analyze complex financial statements and make strategic business recommendations!

steps.title: Financial Ratio Analysis Mastery
steps.narrative: The Investment Firm needs your expertise to analyze company financial health using ratio analysis.

problem.question: A company has Current Assets of ₹5,00,000 and Current Liabilities of ₹2,00,000. What is the Current Ratio and what does it indicate?
problem.explanation: Current Ratio = Current Assets/Current Liabilities = 5,00,000/2,00,000 = 2.5:1. This indicates good short-term liquidity.
